title: athyrium montanum
intro: Athyrium montanum, commonly known as Mountain Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Woodsiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory conditions, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Lady Fern include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium montanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
